basis: Initial reserve before the deductible, by line of business, coverage and severity band. Figures marked PUBLISHED are quoted from the sources in repair-cost-ranges.json; which figure stands for which severity band is this project's mapping, an assumption. They are repair-cost figures, not any insurer's average reserves.
note: Severity bands are the vision model's label; its accuracy is not measured (docs/metrics.md). To be replaced by the insurer's own average reserves.
synthetic: synthetic prototype value — to be replaced by the insurer's own average reserves

MINOR.mapping: AAA's average total repair estimate for a rear collision ($1,698)

MODERATE.mapping: CCC's preliminary 2025 average total cost of repairs ($4,818), across all repairs

SEVERE.mapping: the highest repair figure in the sources: AAA's minor front collision estimate ($11,708). The source calls this minor, so a truly severe loss or a total loss can cost far more

MINOR.mapping: AAA's windshield replacement and calibration estimate ($1,439.78), rounded
